role.instructions: What is the watched fighter in this article? Judge by what the article is actually reporting, not by whose name is in the headline.

criteria.the_subject: The article is about him. He is the person it reports on.
criteria.one_of_several_subjects: He shares the article with others - it reports on two or more people and none of them is the single focus.
criteria.a_bystander: The article reports an exchange, argument or event between other people. He is named but is not a party to it.
criteria.background: His past fight, loss or record is used as backdrop in a story about someone else.
criteria.not_in_this_list: None of the above fits. Choose this only when a fitting answer exists but is not in this list - not when you are merely unsure.

whose_judgement.instructions: Whose judgement of the watched fighter does this article carry? If more than one, pick the one with the most standing to judge him. Note: sharing a gym or a team gives a fighter NO extra standing - a team in this sport is only the club they train at.

criteria.himself: The watched fighter speaking about himself.
criteria.his_camp: His own coach, trainer, manager, doctor or promoter - the people who work for him. NOT another fighter who trains at the same gym.
criteria.an_opponent_or_their_camp: A fighter who faces him or has faced him, or that fighter's coach or manager.
criteria.the_champion_or_a_top_authority: The champion of his division, a leading coach with no stake in him, a doctor, or the promotion and its officials.
criteria.another_fighter: Any other fighter, however well known - including one from the same gym or team. Training in the same place gives no special standing.
criteria.the_article_author: The judgement is the writer's own, in their own voice, not quoted from anyone.
criteria.no_one_judges_him: Nobody, the author included, passes judgement on him. The article only reports facts.
criteria.not_in_this_list: None of the above fits. Choose this only when a fitting answer exists but is not in this list - not when you are merely unsure.

what_is_done.instructions: What is being done with respect to the watched fighter?

criteria.calling_him_out: Asking to fight him, challenging him, or demanding him as an opponent.
criteria.assessing_him: Judging his ability, his game, his career, his chances or his condition.
criteria.defending_him: Replying on his behalf to an attack or a callout aimed at him.
criteria.steering_him_elsewhere: Saying he should fight somebody else, or advising him about his division or weight class.
criteria.naming_him_in_passing: Mentioning him without saying anything substantial about him.
criteria.nothing_of_the_sort: None of these happens. Nobody acts on him or speaks about him in any of these ways.
criteria.not_in_this_list: None of the above fits. Choose this only when a fitting answer exists but is not in this list - not when you are merely unsure.

news_kind.instructions: What kind of news is this about the watched fighter?

criteria.announcement: A specific fight for him is booked or set - an opponent, event or date is named.
criteria.result: The outcome of a fight he fought in the last few days.
criteria.injury: His own new injury, surgery or medical status.
criteria.negotiation: The promotion or both camps working on a fight for him - an offer, terms, talks.
criteria.quote: He, or someone notable, says something substantial about him - an opinion, an assessment, a callout, a stated intention.
criteria.prediction: A forecast about his fight or his path.
criteria.other_career_fact: A career fact fitting nothing else - a contract, a camp change, a ranking move.
criteria.no_news_about_him: Nothing has happened to him and nothing is forecast about him.
criteria.not_in_this_list: None of the above fits. Choose this only when a fitting answer exists but is not in this list - not when you are merely unsure.

sourcing.instructions: How well sourced is what this article asserts about him?

criteria.reported: An outlet states it as fact.
criteria.rumored: Hedged - in talks, targeted, sources say.
criteria.no_factual_claim: The article asserts no fact about him to source. It is opinion, analysis or commentary.
criteria.not_in_this_list: None of the above fits. Choose this only when a fitting answer exists but is not in this list - not when you are merely unsure.

timing.instructions: How fast did a follower of this fighter need this? Judge the news itself, not when the article was published.

criteria.within_hours: Breaking - it loses its value within hours.
criteria.same_day_is_fine: It can wait for a daily digest.
criteria.no_rush: Evergreen - as good next week as today.
criteria.already_old: It was already stale when published: it retells something reported days or months ago.
criteria.not_in_this_list: None of the above fits. Choose this only when a fitting answer exists but is not in this list - not when you are merely unsure.
